translations.literal: if appearance is in Lesser Snow qi, uniformly subtract twenty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: if appearance is in Lesser Snow qi, uniformly subtract twenty-five days.

sentences.zh: 加減平見，以為定見。

translations.literal: Adding and subtracting mean appearance makes fixed appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Adding and subtracting mean appearance makes fixed appearance.

sentences.zh: 諸星各有盈縮之數，皆如此例，但差數不同。

translations.literal: Each star had its numbers of excess and deficit; all followed this pattern, but the difference in numbers was not the same.
translations.idiomatic: Each star had its numbers of excess and deficit; all followed this pattern, but the difference in numbers was not the same.

sentences.zh: 特其積候所知，時人不能原其旨。

translations.literal: Only what he knew from accumulated observation — men of the time could not trace his intent.
translations.idiomatic: Only what he knew from accumulated observation — men of the time could not trace his intent.

sentences.zh: 其二，辰星舊率，一終再見，凡諸古曆，皆以為然。

translations.literal: Second, Mercury's old rate had one completion and two appearances; all ancient calendars held this so.
translations.idiomatic: Second: Mercury's old rate had one completion and two appearances; all ancient calendars held this so.

sentences.zh: 應見不見，人未能測。

translations.literal: When it should appear it did not appear — men could not measure it.
translations.idiomatic: When it should appear it did not appear — men could not measure it.

sentences.zh: 胄玄積候，知辰星一終之中，有時一見。

translations.literal: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that within one completion of Mercury there is sometimes only one appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that within one completion of Mercury there is sometimes only one appearance.

sentences.zh: 及同類感召，相隨而出。

translations.literal: When similar kinds respond and summon one another, they appear together.
translations.idiomatic: When similar kinds respond and summon one another, they appear together.

sentences.zh: 即如辰星，平晨見在雨水者，應見即不見；

translations.literal: Take Mercury: if mean morning appearance is in Rain Water, when it should appear it does not appear;
translations.idiomatic: Take Mercury: if mean morning appearance is in Rain Water, when it should appear it does not appear;

sentences.zh: 若平晨見在啟蟄者，去日十八度外，三十六度內。

translations.literal: if mean morning appearance is in Waking of Insects, it is outside eighteen degrees from the sun and within thirty-six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: if mean morning appearance is in Waking of Insects, it is outside eighteen degrees from the sun and within thirty-six degrees.

sentences.zh: 晨有木火土金一星者，亦相隨見。

translations.literal: If in the morning there is one star among Wood, Fire, Earth, and Metal, it also appears together.
translations.idiomatic: If in the morning there is one star among Wood, Fire, Earth, and Metal, it also appears together.

sentences.zh: 其三，古曆步術，行有定限，自見已後，依率而推，進退之期，莫知多少。

translations.literal: Third, in ancient calendrical step methods, motion had fixed limits; after appearance one followed the rate to calculate — the periods of advance and retreat were unknown in number.
translations.idiomatic: Third: in ancient calendrical step methods, motion had fixed limits; after appearance one followed the rate to calculate — the periods of advance and retreat were unknown in number.

sentences.zh: 胄玄積候，知五星遲速留退真數，皆與古法不同，多者差八十餘日，留回所在，亦差八十餘度。

translations.literal: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew the true numbers of the five planets' slowness, speed, station, and retreat — all differed from ancient methods; at most the difference reached more than eighty days, and the places of station and loop differed by more than eighty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew the true numbers of the five planets' slowness, speed, station, and retreat — all differed from ancient methods; at most the difference reached more than eighty days, and the places of station and loop differed by more than eighty degrees.

sentences.zh: 即如熒惑，前疾初見在立冬初，則二百五十日行一百七十七度；

translations.literal: Take Mars: if the first rapid motion after initial appearance is at the start of Start of Winter, then in two hundred fifty days it travels one hundred seventy-seven degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Take Mars: if the first rapid motion after initial appearance is at the start of Start of Winter, then in two hundred fifty days it travels one hundred seventy-seven degrees;

sentences.zh: 定見夏至初，則一百七十日行九十二度。

translations.literal: if fixed appearance is at the start of summer solstice, then in one hundred seventy days it travels ninety-two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: if fixed appearance is at the start of summer solstice, then in one hundred seventy days it travels ninety-two degrees.

sentences.zh: 追步天驗，今古皆密。

translations.literal: Tracing steps against heavenly verification, ancient and present are alike precise.
translations.idiomatic: Tracing steps against heavenly verification, ancient and present are alike precise.

sentences.zh: 其四，古曆食分，依平即用，推驗多少，實數罕符。

translations.literal: Fourth, in ancient calendars eclipse parts followed the mean and were directly applied; when tested against actual numbers, they rarely matched.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: in ancient calendars eclipse parts followed the mean and were directly applied; when tested against actual numbers, they rarely matched.

sentences.zh: 胄玄積候，知月從木火土金四星行，有向背。

translations.literal: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that when the moon travels with the four stars Wood, Fire, Earth, and Metal, there is facing and backing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that when the moon travels with the four stars Wood, Fire, Earth, and Metal, there is facing and backing.

sentences.zh: 月向四星即速，背之則遲。

translations.literal: When the moon faces the four stars it is fast; when backing them it is slow.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon faces the four stars it is fast; when backing them it is slow.

sentences.zh: 皆十五度外及循本率。

translations.literal: All are outside fifteen degrees and follow the original rate.
translations.idiomatic: All are outside fifteen degrees and follow the original rate.

sentences.zh: 遂於交分，限其多少。

translations.literal: He therefore limited the amount at crossing parts.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore limited the amount at crossing parts.

sentences.zh: 其五，古曆加時，朔望同術。

translations.literal: Fifth, in ancient calendars the added hour of new and full moon used the same method.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: in ancient calendars the added hour of new and full moon used the same method.

sentences.zh: 胄玄積候，知日蝕所在，隨方改變，傍正高下，每處不同。

translations.literal: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that the place of solar eclipse changes with region — side, directness, high, and low differ at each place.
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that the place of solar eclipse changes with region — side, directness, high, and low differ at each place.

sentences.zh: 交有淺深，遲速亦異，約時立差，皆會天象。

translations.literal: Crossings have shallow and deep, slowness and speed also differ; approximating the time he established difference — all matching heavenly phenomena.
translations.idiomatic: Crossings have shallow and deep, slowness and speed also differ; approximating the time he established difference — all matching heavenly phenomena.

sentences.zh: 其六，古曆交分即為蝕數，去交十四度者，食一分；

translations.literal: Sixth, in ancient calendars crossing parts were directly taken as eclipse numbers: at fourteen degrees from crossing, one part eclipsed;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: in ancient calendars crossing parts were directly taken as eclipse numbers: at fourteen degrees from crossing, one part eclipsed;

sentences.zh: 去交十三度，食二分；

translations.literal: at thirteen degrees from crossing, two parts;
translations.idiomatic: at thirteen degrees from crossing, two parts;

sentences.zh: 去交十度，食三分；

translations.literal: at ten degrees, three parts;
translations.idiomatic: at ten degrees, three parts;

sentences.zh: 每近一度，食益一分；

translations.literal: each nearer by one degree, one part more eclipsed;
translations.idiomatic: each nearer by one degree, one part more eclipsed;

sentences.zh: 當交即蝕既。

translations.literal: at exact crossing the eclipse was total.
translations.idiomatic: at exact crossing the eclipse was total.

sentences.zh: 其應多少，自古諸曆，未悉其原。

translations.literal: How much should correspond — in calendars of antiquity none fully knew the origin.
translations.idiomatic: How much should correspond — in calendars of antiquity none fully knew the origin.

sentences.zh: 胄玄積候，知當交之中，月掩日不能畢盡，故其蝕反少；

translations.literal: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that at exact crossing the moon cannot completely cover the sun, so the eclipse is conversely less;
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that at exact crossing the moon cannot completely cover the sun, so the eclipse is conversely less;

sentences.zh: 去交五六時，月在日內，掩日便盡，故其蝕及既。

translations.literal: at five or six degrees from crossing, when the moon is within the sun, covering the sun it is complete, so the eclipse reaches totality.
translations.idiomatic: at five or six degrees from crossing, when the moon is within the sun, covering the sun it is complete, so the eclipse reaches totality.

sentences.zh: 自此以後，更遠者，其蝕又少。

translations.literal: From this point farther, the eclipse is again less.
translations.idiomatic: From this point farther, the eclipse is again less.

sentences.zh: 交之前後，在冬至，皆爾。

translations.literal: Before and after crossing, at winter solstice, all are so.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after crossing, at winter solstice, all are so.

sentences.zh: 若近夏至，其率又差。

translations.literal: If near summer solstice, the rate again differs.
translations.idiomatic: If near summer solstice, the rate again differs.

sentences.zh: 胄玄所立蝕分，最為詳密。

translations.literal: The eclipse parts Zhouxuan established are the most detailed.
translations.idiomatic: The eclipse parts Zhouxuan established are the most detailed.

sentences.zh: 其七，古曆二分，晝夜皆等。

translations.literal: Seventh, in ancient calendars at the two equinoxes day and night were equal.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: in ancient calendars at the two equinoxes day and night were equal.

sentences.zh: 胄玄積候，知其有差。

translations.literal: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that there is difference.
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxuan's accumulated observation knew that there is difference.

sentences.zh: 春、秋二分，晝多夜漏半刻。

translations.literal: At the spring and autumn equinoxes, daytime exceeds night by half a clepsydra mark.
translations.idiomatic: At the spring and autumn equinoxes, daytime exceeds night by half a clepsydra mark.

sentences.zh: 皆由日行遲疾盈縮使其然也。

translations.literal: All because the sun's motion slow and fast, excess and deficit, make it so.
translations.idiomatic: All because the sun's motion slow and fast, excess and deficit, make it so.

sentences.zh: 凡此，胄玄獨得於心，論者服其精密。

translations.literal: In all this Zhouxuan alone grasped it in his heart; critics acknowledged his precision.
translations.idiomatic: In all this Zhouxuan alone grasped it in his heart; critics acknowledged his precision.

sentences.zh: 大業中，卒於官。

translations.literal: In the Daye era he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daye era he died in office.
